signin.consent.heading: For an administrator
signin.consent.link: Approve the panel for the whole organisation
signin.consent.message: An administrator of your Microsoft 365 organisation can approve the panel for the whole organisation with this link. You go to Microsoft and the panel cannot see the result, so sign in again afterwards.
signin.error.access_denied: The sign-in was cancelled or refused at Microsoft.
signin.error.admin_approval_required: Microsoft requires an administrator to approve the panel before you can use it.
signin.error.amr_missing: Microsoft did not tell the panel how you signed in (the optional claim amr is missing), so multi-factor authentication cannot be checked.
signin.error.assignment_required: Your account is not assigned to the panel in Microsoft Entra.
signin.error.conditional_access_blocked: A Conditional Access policy of your organisation blocked this sign-in.
signin.error.consent_required: The panel has not been approved for your organisation yet.
signin.error.cookies_missing_or_expired: Your sign-in attempt expired, or your browser did not keep its cookie.
signin.error.interaction_required: Microsoft needs you to sign in again.
signin.error.mfa_required: Your sign-in did not include multi-factor authentication (MFA), and this panel requires it (AUTH_REQUIRE_MFA).
signin.error.secrets_unavailable: The panel cannot use its encryption key or certificate, so signing in is unavailable.
signin.error.setup_required: The panel is not set up yet.
signin.error.stepup_failed: The extra verification for this action did not succeed.
signin.heading: Sign in to {name}
signin.intro: Use the Microsoft 365 account of your organisation. The panel lets in only people who have a role here.
signin.remedy.access_denied: Sign in again and accept the request, or use another account.
signin.remedy.admin_approval_required: Ask an administrator of your Microsoft 365 organisation to approve it (the link below is meant for them), then sign in again.
signin.remedy.amr_missing: Ask an administrator who can still sign in, or the operator of the panel, to repair the connection (Settings, Connection). That registers the optional claim amr again.
signin.remedy.assignment_required: Ask your Microsoft Entra administrator to assign you, or a group you belong to, to the enterprise application of this panel. Then sign in again.
signin.remedy.conditional_access_blocked: Ask your administrator which condition was not met, for example a compliant device or a trusted location, and fix it or ask for an exception.
signin.remedy.consent_required: Ask an administrator of your Microsoft 365 organisation to approve it (the link below is meant for them), then sign in again.
signin.remedy.cookies_missing_or_expired: Start again from this page and finish within a few minutes. Make sure cookies are allowed for this site, and do not open the sign-in in two tabs at once.
signin.remedy.interaction_required: Choose "Sign in again". Microsoft will then ask for your password or approval.
signin.remedy.mfa_required: Ask your administrator to turn on Security Defaults or a Conditional Access policy that requires MFA, then sign in again. The operator of this panel can switch the requirement off with AUTH_REQUIRE_MFA=false, but that lowers security.
signin.remedy.secrets_unavailable: Tell the operator of the panel: check APP_KEY or APP_KEY_FILE and restart the container. Break-glass access still works when it is configured.
signin.remedy.session_expired: Sign in again to continue. You come back to the page you were on.
signin.remedy.setup_required: The operator must finish the setup wizard first. The setup token is printed by the setup-token command.
signin.remedy.signin_failed: Try again. If it keeps failing, tell your administrator and mention the time you tried.
signin.remedy.stepup_failed: Start the action again and complete the Microsoft verification with MFA. If your tenant never asks for MFA, ask your administrator to turn on Security Defaults or a Conditional Access policy that requires it.
signin.remedy.temporarily_unavailable: Wait a minute and sign in again.
signin.signedOut.message: Your session has ended. Sign in again when you want to continue.
signin.signedOut.title: You are signed out
signin.title: Sign in
